featured_review.title: Astrophysical Software Review
featured_review.subtitle: A Living Community Review of Modern Open-Source Software in Observational Cosmology, Survey Science & Scientific AI
featured_review.summary: We are building a comprehensive, living review and taxonomy of the modern astrophysical software ecosystem powering petabyte-scale sky surveys (Vera C. Rubin LSST, Nancy Grace Roman, Gaia, eROSITA). The review evaluates scalable spatial partitioning (HATS/LSDB, HEALPix/HEALSparse), angular selection functions, astrostatistics and Bayesian inference, fast correlation engines, and Scientific Machine Learning / Multimodal Foundation Models.

pillars.title: Survey Masks & Spatial Partitioning
pillars.description: Evaluating HEALSparse/HATS/LSDB data architectures, multi-order coverage maps (MOCs), bright-star masking, and footprint optimization (Skykatana, El Zorro).

pillars.title: Astrostatistics & Fast Correlation Engines
pillars.description: Benchmarking point-redshift and photometric PDF-aware spatial correlation functions, Bayesian inference, and surrogate modeling (νGundam/Corrgi, Arby).

pillars.title: Scientific ML & Foundation Models
pillars.description: Surveying Mixture-of-Experts architectures, spatial calibration, multimodal foundation models, and difference-image transient classifiers (Pontifex, LSST-DESC AI/ML).

pillars.title: Reproducible Open-Science Pipelines
pillars.description: Reviewing trustworthy data-intensive parallel pipelines, containerization, provenance tracking, and open community governance (Corral, MeSsI).

packages.name: Pontifex
packages.tagline: Mixture-of-Experts with Spatial Calibration for Rubin–Roman Photo-z
packages.description: A Mixture-of-Experts deep learning architecture incorporating spatial calibration for the Rubin–Roman Photometric Redshift Challenge, accepted at NeurIPS 2026.

packages.name: Skykatana
packages.tagline: Scalable Sky Masks for Vera Rubin Observatory & Large Surveys
packages.description: Low-memory Python framework built on HEALSparse and HATS/LSDB to construct, combine, and validate complex angular selection functions, bright-star halos, and multi-order coverage maps.

packages.name: νGundam / Corrgi
packages.tagline: Unified Point-Redshift & PDF-Aware Spatial Correlation Functions
packages.description: High-performance framework (Python + Fortran) for lightspeed pair counts and spatial two-point correlation functions supporting both point redshifts and full photo-z probability distributions.

packages.name: El Zorro
packages.tagline: Scalable Survey Geometry & Catalog Tooling on HATS/LSDB
packages.description: Open-source companion tool developed under the LSST-DA LINCC Frameworks Incubator Program Cohort 4 for high-speed mask operations and survey characterization.

packages.name: Arby
packages.description: Python module implementing reduced basis and empirical interpolation methods to construct fast, accurate data-driven surrogate models from numerical simulations.

packages.name: Corral Framework
packages.description: Python MVC and relational-database pipeline framework designed for fault-tolerant, data-intensive parallel processing in time-domain and gravitational-wave follow-up surveys (TOROS).

packages.name: MeSsI
packages.description: Automated astrostatistical algorithm and catalog pipeline for identifying merging galaxy clusters and substructures via Gaussian mixture modeling and dynamical tests.
